synthetic_execution_fixture.finding: Engine processes eligible NEXT_BAR orders before Strategy.on_data at the current timestamp. An order submitted by the strategy at the 30m decision boundary cannot fill at the 5m open with that same timestamp; it fills five minutes later.
synthetic_execution_fixture.required_invariant: First executable 5m open at or after event_timestamp + 30m, which is 00:30Z in this fixture.

verified_engine_semantics.oco: PASS. Full fill cancels another pending order with the same parent_id.
verified_engine_semantics.same_bar_stop_target_tie: PASS. Submit the stop child before the target child. EXIT_FIRST preserves exit submission order. The stop fills and the OCO target cancels.
verified_engine_semantics.target_only: PASS. Target limit fills and the OCO stop cancels.
verified_engine_semantics.gap_down_stop: PASS. Sell stop fills from the bar open when open is below stop, then applies configured slippage. The realized price is no better than the available open.
verified_engine_semantics.terminal_close: PASS. MOC submitted on the final data bar fills at that bar close. The engine does not automatically close terminal positions.
verified_engine_semantics.cash_validation: PASS. Insufficient cash rejects the oversized entry.
verified_engine_semantics.cost_units: PASS. Commission uses 0.000025 of notional per side. Percentage slippage uses 0.00005 per side. The fixture reconciles engine trade fees and slippage.
verified_engine_semantics.bracket_api_note: Broker.submit_bracket submits the target child before the stop child. The tested stop-first variant submitted separate children in stop-first order and assigned the shared parent_id used by native sibling cancellation.

stop_reason: The required 30m-close decision and same-boundary 5m open cannot both be represented by the installed Strategy/NEXT_BAR callback order. The first causal submission at 00:30Z fills at 00:35Z. Submitting during the preceding 00:25Z callback would submit before the decision is available. This violates the frozen entry timestamp contract.
attempt_history: Initial synthetic test run found six test-fixture/API expectation failures. The attempt did not evaluate the research signal.
Second synthetic test run found three cost and fill-price assertion mismatches. The attempt did not evaluate the research signal.
The fixtures were corrected to assert costs after per-unit slippage, actual MOC closure and non-finite feature parity. The final test suite passed 7 tests.
